THE RULES I WORK BY
An idea must be thought before it is built — never the other way around. I don't decorate. I direct.
01

Concept first, pixels second. If the idea isn't sharp, no amount of polish saves it.

02

Scroll is a camera. Every site I build moves like a film — chapters, beats, reveals.

03

Restraint wins. One idea per screen. Whitespace is a material, not emptiness.

04

Straight talk. I'll tell you when an idea is weak — before your users do.

AirPods Pro
